notes: The common Conversations root now renders deterministic empty and load-error states with one shared retry action instead of leaving an empty list visually blank. Successful repository loads and realtime emissions clear only the dedicated load error; operational errors retain their separate state.

Web/Wasm executes the two common host tests and builds the production distribution. Android executes the same loading, empty, error and two-retry sequence in one API 35 instrumented test. iOS executes the two common host tests on the x86_64 test host and compiles the ios-shared aggregate from the same exact checkout.

The existing conversations-postflight and conversation-invites-parity manifests remain authoritative for authenticated list/search/exact-thread/favorites/picker and platform invitation behavior. Those backend-bearing matrices were not repeated because this change only adds terminal root presentation and clears stale error state.

This postflight does not certify a filtered-search empty result, private or group conversation creation, deep pagination against the live backend, search persistence after relaunch, reconnect/background lifecycle or a global SCR-CONVERSATIONS GO.

No backend mutation was needed. Raw local XML reports, host paths, device identifiers and build logs remain unversioned; the committed evidence files are sanitized projections bound to their SHA-256 digests.

Any executable, workflow, runner, source, resource, test, configuration or dependency change after productSha invalidates the affected evidence; attestation-only documentation remains subject to scripts/validate-candidate-attestation.mjs.
